title: Bounded finite-evaluation replacement of a cocycle by a rectangle residual
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a profinite group $G$, an open subgroup $H\subseteq G$ of index $m$ prime to $\ell$, an integer $n\geq1$, and $a_0,\ldots,a_n\in G$. For a nonarchimedean normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-vector space $V$ (not necessarily complete), with $\|v\|=0$ exactly for $v=0$, $\|a v\|=|a|_\ell\|v\|$ and $\|v+w\|\leq\max(\|v\|,\|w\|)$, and with the norm topology, set $C^r(G,V)=C(G^r,V)$, with trivial group action and differential
$$(dc)(g_1,\ldots,g_{r+1})=c(g_2,\ldots,g_{r+1})+\sum_{i=1}^r(-1)^i c(g_1,\ldots,g_ig_{i+1},\ldots,g_{r+1})+(-1)^{r+1}c(g_1,\ldots,g_r),$$
where $d^0=0$. There are linear operators $T:C^n(G,V)\to C^{n-1}(G,V)$ and $R:C^n(G,V)\to C^n(G,V)$ given by fixed finite sums of evaluations
$$(Tc)(x)=\sum_{j=1}^u\alpha_j c(\psi_j(x)),\qquad (Rc)(y)=\sum_{j=1}^v\beta_j c(\chi_j(y)),$$
where $\psi_j:G^{n-1}\to G^n$ and $\chi_j:G^n\to G^n$ are continuous, $\alpha_j,\beta_j\in\mathbf Q_\ell$ have absolute value at most one, and all these choices depend only on $G,H,n,(a_i)$, not on $V$. For every cocycle $c$, $Rc$ is a cocycle and $c=d(Tc)+Rc$. If the homogeneous function $f_c(g_0,\ldots,g_n)=c(g_0^{-1}g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1}^{-1}g_n)$ vanishes on $Ha_0\times\cdots\times Ha_n$, then $Rc=0$. The operators have supremum-norm bound one, preserve every $\mathbf Q_\ell$-linear coefficient subspace, and apply to continuous profinite parameter families by leaving the parameter fixed; the resulting families are continuous. The conventions for $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and universes are [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], [def-weil-size-convention].

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-coset-averaged-homogeneous-residual] with $E=Ha_0\times\cdots\times Ha_n$. Set $\bar U=\mathcal M_{n-1}U$ and $\bar W=\mathcal M_nW$. For $F=\Psi c$ closed, its statement gives $F=\delta\bar UF+\bar WF$, $\delta\bar WF=0$, and $\bar WF=0$ if $F|_E=0$. Both operators take invariant continuous cochains to invariant continuous cochains with fixed evaluation coefficients $k/m$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent auxiliary scalar tame-kernel expansion; assembly of the four extracted obligations, following retained proof steps 1–14.

proof.text: Define $T=\Phi_{n-1}\bar U\Psi_n$ and $R=\Phi_n\bar W\Psi_n$ on all cochains. The cochain-map identities give $c=d(Tc)+Rc$, $d(Rc)=0$, and the required rectangle implication. Explicitly substitute the cumulative-product tuple from $\Phi$ into each averaged tuple map $b$, then send $b=(b_0,\ldots,b_n)$ to $(b_0^{-1}b_1,\ldots,b_{n-1}^{-1}b_n)$ from $\Psi$. These are the maps $\psi_j,\chi_j$, continuous with the stated domains; the finite coefficients remain $k/m$ and all choices precede $V$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-nonarchimedean-finite-evaluation-calculus] to these evaluation lists on the nonempty compact powers of $G$. Since $m$ is prime to $\ell$, it gives coefficient bound one, both supremum bounds, every linear coefficient subspace, and continuous parameter formulas leaving the parameter fixed. All cochain identities hold on every slice. For $n=1$, $Tc$ is a function on the point $G^0$ and its trivial-action differential is $d^0=0$, included in step 1; empty parameters and $V=0$ are included.
